categories.name: mempool
categories.evidence: Matches the 'TX fees and policy' label and directly modifies 'src/policy/feerate.h' to validate deserialized fee rate data.
categories.rationale: Prevents potential assertion failures or incorrect fee calculations from invalid deserialized CFeeRate streams. While nothing on master currently deserializes CFeeRate, this defensive fix addresses a latent issue discovered by fuzzing and prepares for IPC interfaces like #29409.
